data.title: Audio Issue
data.description:
The iPhone SE 2022 is one of the best phones on the market, considering its audio output quality. It has a dual stereo speaker with noise cancelation and spatial audio features. It has two speaker grills in the bottom part of the phone. Should keep in mind that, the left speaker grill is not a speaker but instead it is there to catch audio inputs for your voice calls and Siri. The audio only comes out of the right speaker grill and is not a faulty feature. The two speakers of the iPhone SE 2022 are located on the top and the bottom of the phone. The top speaker also serves its purpose as an ear speaker when on calls. However, some users have reported a lot of different audio issues. The most common audio issues faced by iPhone SE 2022 users are:

No sound on audio playback

No sound on voice calls

Distorted/Low sound on the speakers

Headphones not working

Audio not working or audio levels low after an update.

Phone stuck in Headphone mode

Ringer Switch not working/ Audio level increases or decreases automatically/ Physical audio level buttons not working.

These issues are the most common audio issues reported by users in the Apple support forum. There are some “Do it yourself” fixes available and advised to be attempted as a “first aid” for your audio issues by Apple professionals and users. They are:

Check the ringer switch to see if it is in sound mode

Restarting Your Phone

Disabling your Bluetooth on the iPhone SE 2022

Check if your phone is in DND (Do not disturb) mode

Check the sound notification settings and try turning noise cancelation off.

Try using headphones and check if the sounds come okay in headphones.

Try removing any protective cases

Clean speaker grills for dirt and debris

data.title: Stuck On Logo
data.description:
The new iPhone Se 2022 offers its users better optimization and balance in software than the previous iPhone models. However, no matter hard they try there can always be some technical issues that can result in your iPhone malfunctioning. The Apple logo stuck issue was also found in previous iPhones and it’s a frustrating issue. Your iPhone boots up, but instead of going to the home screen, it is stuck on the boot menu. This problem happens mainly/most of the time because of a software issue that happens due to an unclean or interrupted update.

This Stuck on Apple logo issue might happen in other instances too. Possible reasons might be:

The iPhone has taken some physical damage. (Dropping from hand)

Update was disrupted due to Wi-Fi disturbance/metered connection or cellular data loss

A third-party app may have access to vital permissions that can disrupt iPhones' productivity

It is rare, however, your phone might be facing a hardware issue. Sometimes faulty hardware prevents the phone from booting up

These issues however can be resolved if it is just a bug or a glitch in the iOS software. You may try the following steps and see if it works for you.

Force Restart your iPhone Se 2022 (Press volume up (+) and then quickly press the volume down (-) button and hold the iPhone Se 2022 power button as long as the apple logo appears again)

Update your iOS Software. (If, while in the progress of updating your software, the progress bar under the Apple logo has not moved for an hour, You may connect your iPhone to a PC and select “Update” when prompted)

Remove all third-party apps from your phone. Install Apps only from the Apple App store

Turn off the auto-update of your iOS apps to prevent further interruptions. BUT BE SURE TO UPDATE THEM ON A REGULAR BASIS MANUALLY.

If none of the fixes above work, for you. You might have an issue that needs the touch of a professional iPhone technician. Signs that indicate a faulty touch mechanism in iPhone Se 2022 are...

Doesn’t work or No response / Program doesn’t open or respond after touching the icon

Delayed response or wrong response (Clicking on one place but the phone registers the touch elsewhere and opens an unrelated app)

Takes multiple touch attempts to open an app or perform an action on the phone.

Rinse your phone with a lens cloth or a microfiber cloth

The phone's display boots up with an Apple logo but doesn’t get past the black screen (iPhone 6 – 8Plus)

Force Restart your iPhone. (Press the volume up (+) and volume down (-) and then press and hold the power button until the Apple logo appears on the screen) 

Connect the lightning cable and charge it for 10 minutes. Then try force restarting the iPhone

You are asked to enter the passcode to unlock the phone by default instead of Touch ID

Can’t Register Touch ID to set up your fingerprint

Restarted your phone
